details: On July 3, 2026, Bitcoin saw a significant rally, climbing above $62,000, as US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded $221 million in net inflows. This marked the end of a ten-day streak of outflows for these institutional investment products. The positive sentiment was further bolstered by a weaker-than-expected US jobs report for June, which showed only 57,000 new jobs added against an anticipated 115,000. This softer labor data has eased fears of immediate interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve, making risk assets like cryptocurrencies more attractive. Ethereum and other altcoins also experienced gains following these developments.
title: Bitcoin Rallies on US ETF Inflows and Soft Jobs Data

details: Despite the recent cryptocurrency rally, ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East persist as a significant factor influencing global financial markets and, by extension, cryptocurrencies. Reports indicate that inflation, energy prices, and the general macroeconomic environment continue to be shaped by the conflict. While not a new escalation in the last 24-48 hours, the sustained uncertainty and potential for disruption emanating from the region mean that investors remain cautious, weighing these risks against positive market catalysts.
title: Geopolitical Tensions in Middle East Continue to Influence Markets
